pt.r: O Parque Nacional de Congaree fica na Carolina do Sul, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 106 km² e está protegido desde 2003, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). en.r: Congaree National Park is a national park in South Carolina, United States. It covers 106 km² and has been protected since 2003. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: A grassroots campaign begun in 1969 against logging led to a national monument in 1976 and a national park in 2003.
en.ff: It protects the largest tract of old-growth bottomland hardwood forest left in the US. Its trees are among the tallest in the eastern US, forming one of the highest temperate deciduous canopies in the world, with bald cypress and tupelo. Synchronous fireflies light up in May and June.
